semantic_executor.measurement: For each case, target_score is the mapped target code's single next-token logit minus the mean of the other two selected code-token logits.

native_harness.token_triplet_resolution: The harness selects the first globally single-token distinct triplet among bare A/B/C, space-prefixed A/B/C, then 1/2/3.
native_harness.important_positive: The harness already rejects non-single-token or non-distinct triplets, so raw token-count asymmetry inside the selected triplet is not the primary gap.

new_measurement_gap.statement: A globally valid one-token symbol is not necessarily the context-faithful completion token for the exact prompt boundary. The current harness resolves one token form globally, then scores only its next-token logit; it does not prove that this token form is the model's actual code realization at the exact prompt boundary or that the logit winner agrees with emitted text.
new_measurement_gap.why_counterbalance_does_not_fully_close_: Rotating semantic targets across A/B/C cancels a fixed label prior better than a fixed mapping, but does not guarantee cancellation when intervention changes whitespace/style/token-form preference or when the scored token form is not the form used by generation. A treatment-dependent change in output form can therefore move the measured logits without a matching semantic code selection behavior.
new_measurement_gap.second_gap: Replication is currently tied to one answer-symbol family. Even exact A/B/C counterbalancing can remain family-specific if the intervention interacts with alphabetic option-symbol priors or symbol binding rather than the requested semantic state.

counterhypothesis.statement: Because every intervention is compared with a matched baseline on the exact same prompt and A/B/C targets are counterbalanced, any stable symbol-token preference should cancel sufficiently for the causal contrast.
counterhypothesis.falsifier: If context-bound tokenization, equivalent codebook families and emitted-text decisions preserve the same treatment-by-semantic-target interaction and sign under the frozen intervention, the simpler single-token logit metric is supported as an adequate surrogate at this scope.

primary_hypothesis.statement: A genuine semantic steering effect should survive changes in answer-symbol realization and should agree between context-valid code likelihoods and actual constrained/generated code behavior, not only within one globally resolved A/B/C token triplet.
primary_hypothesis.prediction: The preregistered semantic target x intervention interaction keeps its direction across at least two lexically disjoint codebook families with exact prompt-boundary tokenization, and the same target preference is observed in generated/constrained code selection.

external_primary_inputs.source: Wang et al. (2024), My Answer is C: First-Token Probabilities Do Not Match Text Answers in Instruction-Tuned Language Models, arXiv:2402.14499
external_primary_inputs.relevance: Reports severe mismatch between first-token MCQ probability evaluation and text answers, including under increasingly constrained prompts; motivates a generated-text agreement gate rather than treating next-token logits as behavioral ground truth.

external_primary_inputs.source: Sanz-Guerrero, Bui, von der Wense (2025), Mind the Gap: A Closer Look at Tokenization for Multiple-Choice Question Answering with LLMs, arXiv:2509.15020
external_primary_inputs.relevance: Shows that seemingly minor answer-boundary whitespace/tokenization choices can materially change MCQA accuracy and rankings; directly motivates exact prompt-boundary tokenization attestation.

external_primary_inputs.source: Zheng et al. (2023), Large Language Models Are Not Robust Multiple Choice Selectors, arXiv:2309.03882
external_primary_inputs.relevance: Attributes option-selection bias partly to token priors over option identifiers; motivates disjoint codebook-family replication rather than relying only on within-family label rotation.

external_primary_inputs.source: Wang et al. (2024), Look at the Text: Instruction-Tuned Language Models are More Robust Multiple Choice Selectors than You Think, arXiv:2404.08382
external_primary_inputs.relevance: Finds text-answer evaluation more robust than first-token probability evaluation in mismatch regimes; supports keeping a behavioral emission readout alongside logits.

proposed_discriminator.name: CONTEXT_BOUNDARY_AWARE_MULTI_CODEBOOK_GENERATION_AGREEMENT/v1
phase_0_freeze: Freeze exact Qwen3-0.6B checkpoint/GGUF, tokenizer, llama.cpp build, layer, token-scope condition, vector bytes, gain-selection rule, semantic-target factorial and all existing controls before opening fresh holdout.
Do not choose symbol family, whitespace form, decoding parser or threshold after observing holdout effects.
phase_1_context_boundary_attestation: For every exact evaluation prompt and candidate output symbol, attest that tokenize(prompt + completion_form) has the exact tokenize(prompt) sequence as a prefix and yields a declared suffix token sequence; otherwise reject that prompt/form combination rather than silently scoring a globally tokenizable symbol.
Prefer a deliberately stable answer boundary such as a frozen output delimiter whose tokenization is tested at source/runtime identity.
Persist exact prompt token IDs, completion suffix token IDs, token texts and tokenizer identity in the receipt.

phase_2_codebook_family_replication.minimum: At least two disjoint symbol families that are context-boundary valid and exactly counterbalanced, for example alphabetic and numeric/symbolic families when the exact tokenizer supports them cleanly.
phase_2_codebook_family_replication.mapping: Within each family, rotate requested semantic targets independently over the three code identities exactly as in the semantic-target x output-code factorial.
phase_2_codebook_family_replication.decision: A semantic claim requires the target-specific causal interaction to retain direction across codebook families; family-specific effect or sign reversal is negative evidence for output-symbol independence.

phase_3_dual_readout.logit_readout: Use the context-attested completion token sequence, not a globally chosen token form. For single-token suffixes, preserve the current margin metric; for multi-token suffixes, use a preregistered length-normalized sequence log-likelihood rule or reject multi-token families.
phase_3_dual_readout.behavioral_readout: Run a separately declared constrained-choice decode over only the three exact context-valid completions, and also record a short greedy text emission parsed by a frozen strict code parser where feasible.
phase_3_dual_readout.agreement_gate: The semantic-intervention ordering must agree between the preregistered logit/sequence metric and constrained code selection. Unconstrained text disagreement is preserved as negative evidence and blocks claims about emitted behavior even if internal/logit causal measurement remains positive.

phase_5_decision.promotion_support: Target-specific effect survives semantic-target counterbalance, lexical-family holdout, token-scope/norm calibration, context-boundary attestation, at least two codebook families and dual readout agreement with nuisance controls negative.
phase_5_decision.measurement_only: Logit effect survives but constrained/generated code choice does not: retain internal/logit measurement credit only; do not call it emitted semantic behavior.
phase_5_decision.reject_output_independence: Effect is materially dependent on symbol family, whitespace/token form or output parser: classify current result as output-realization-sensitive and do not promote canonical semantics.

relationship_to_existing_forschungsrun_1.reason: Those gates address what semantic contrast is built, where/how it is injected and whether semantic targets are independently varied. This gate asks whether the downstream measurement itself is context-valid and invariant to output-symbol realization.

source_only_first: Add a deterministic token-boundary auditor for the exact prompt x codebook combinations.
Extend the native harness header/observation receipt with exact context-attested token forms and IDs rather than only one globally resolved triplet.
Add a source regression that rejects a completion form whose prompt-plus-completion tokenization does not preserve the prompt token prefix.
Extend the promotion gate to require codebook-family replication and readout-agreement metadata before emitted-semantic promotion.
implementation_delta_recommended.reason: The source-level measurement contract can be made fail-closed without spending the unusual-experiment budget. Executing the new native intervention/readout discriminator remains a separate coordinated experiment.

unusual_experiment.reason: This standalone research trigger does not expose a canonical shared immutable macrocycle/request identity plus successful create-only unusual-experiment lease. No new native intervention was executed.

research_delta: Forschungsrun 1 identifies a downstream measurement-validity boundary not closed by existing counterbalancing: the native harness scores one globally resolved answer-token triplet but does not attest exact prompt-boundary completion tokenization, replicate across disjoint output-code families, or require agreement with constrained/generated code behavior. The next promotion discriminator should therefore be context-boundary aware, codebook-family replicated and dual-readout, while retaining all existing semantic, lexical, token-scope, norm and nuisance controls.
next_exact_action: Implement a deterministic source-only context-boundary/codebook auditor and fail-closed promotion metadata first; then, only under canonical unusual-experiment coordination, run the frozen multi-codebook dual-readout native cvec discriminator on fresh holdout.
